007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Tool;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.SqlToolParams;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolAttributes;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolType;
016
017/**
018 * Updates an existing SQL tool's profile through typed tool parameters.
019 *
020 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD},
021 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME}, and
022 * {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME}. Both the SQL tool and the new profile must
023 * already exist. This sample changes the stored tool configuration; it does
024 * not run the tool or restore its previous parameters.</p>
025 *
026 * <p>The submitted {@code tool_params} contains only {@code profile_name}.
027 * Do not assume the database merges nested parameter objects: include any
028 * other parameters that must remain configured for your tool.</p>
029 *
030 * @see CreateSqlToolSample
031 * @see LoadToolSample
032 */
033public final class SetSqlToolParamsSample {
034
035    private SetSqlToolParamsSample() {
036    }
037
038    /**
039     * Changes the configured profile without executing the SQL tool.
040     *
041     * @param args unused command-line arguments
042     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
043     */
044    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
045        String toolName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME");
046        SqlToolParams params = SqlToolParams.builder()
047                .profileName(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME"))
048                .build();
049        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
050            Tool tool = client.tool(toolName);
051            if (!ToolType.SQL.equals(tool.getToolAttributes().getToolType())) {
052                throw new IllegalArgumentException("The selected tool must have type SQL");
053            }
054            boolean updated = tool.setAttributes(ToolAttributes.builder().toolParams(params).build());
055            System.out.printf("Set parameters on SQL tool '%s' completed: %s%n", toolName, updated);
056        }
057    }
058
059    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
060        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
061                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
062                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
063                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
064                .build());
065    }
066
067    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
068        String value = System.getenv(name);
069        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
070            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
071        }
072        return value;
073    }
074}
